hardware.label: Viking 1 lander
hardware.provenance: NASA MODEL (NASA 3D Resources: Viking Lander), scaled so the footpad triangle is 2.21 m (NSSDCA). Orientation ILLUSTRATIVE (not sourced). Component regions (mast head, turret, cameras...) are groups of the model's own triangles identified by this project (scripts/mars/model_views.py), not separate NASA parts.

origin.source: HiRISE-identified lander, PSP_001521_2025 controlled orthoimage (this project, M5)
origin.registration: Lander identified by eye in the USGS controlled orthoimage PSP_001521_2025 (22 Nov 2006, the frame in which the HiRISE team located it): a bright lander with its shadow just south-east of a shallow crater, matching the HiRISE team's annotated cutouts (uahirise.org/PSP_001521_2025). Measured in this controlled frame; 231 m north and 26 m west of the catalogue coordinate (22.269 N, 312.049 E; Folkner et al. 1997).

terrain.dtm: USGS Astrogeology controlled HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001521_2025_001719_2025_U01 (collection mro_hirise_socet_dtms)
terrain.albedo: HiRISE orthoimage (RED band, single channel) at 0.5 m, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
terrain.horizon: same DTM, decimated to ~24 m, out to ~9 km where the DTM covers it
